name: data-table
title: Data table
description: Table with sortable headers, row selection, status cells, and an empty state.

contract: data-sortable on .uifa-table: th button click sets aria-sort ascending|descending and reorders rows
data-state="empty" renders the single empty row
th data-uifa-slot="select" change syncs tbody checkboxes

docs: Mark the table `data-sortable` to wire header buttons; they set `aria-sort` on the `th` and re-order rows in place. Status cells are `[data-uifa-slot="status"]` spans mapping to the ok/warn/danger roles. For an empty table, use `data-state="empty"` with a single `[data-uifa-slot="empty"]` row.
